//: REFERENCE ONLY. This plugin declares no MCP servers of its own.
//why: Declaring a server makes the host ask the user to create a connection owned by this plugin, duplicating a connector they very likely already have, and showing meaningless names like 'warehouse' in their connector list. Instead, connect your providers however you normally do and point tool_bindings at the tool names they expose.
//use: If you genuinely need a dedicated endpoint, copy an entry into your own MCP configuration, not into the plugin.
//hosts: Every url is a placeholder, including the tracker's. Most hosted trackers publish an MCP endpoint; use theirs. The plugin assumes no particular vendor.
